Triple A One A, three pieces, one team.

Triple A is a digital agency in Blida for businesses, creators and individuals. I named it, designed its brand and built its platform: an animated website in French, Arabic and English that the partners update themselves.

Triple A

What it does

The brand A name, and an A in three pieces. Each piece of the A is a pole of the team: build, grow, protect. None stands alone, and the site tells it with the logo itself.
The motion The A assembles, falls, then stands. A first-visit intro, a curtain between pages, project screens floating in 3D, and an A that only stands once its three pieces are in.
The sound Sound design, without one audio file. Each logo animation has its own sound, made in the browser with the Web Audio API. One button mutes it, and the choice is remembered.
The platform The partners run the site themselves. Projects, services, client logos and every text in three languages, from an admin panel. A change is online within minutes, and clients ask for a call from the contact page.

What to look for

  1. Open the home page: on a first visit, the A assembles while the site loads.
  2. Go to another page: a curtain closes on the next page’s name.
  3. Open Solutions and scroll: the A rises piece by piece, and stands only once the crossbar locks in.
  4. Switch to Arabic: the whole site reads right to left.
  5. Click once anywhere for the sound; the button with three bars mutes it.

Triple A was my partners’ idea. I gave it its name, designed the brand, then designed and built the platform: the website, its motion and sound, the admin panel and the booking.
